shuffleShare.description: Share of a level's movable tiles that start shuffled (1 = the game's own puzzle). The rest start in their correct place and are pinned with a dot, like the game's fixed tiles. Applies from the next level started or restarted. Lower values make shorter, easier puzzles.

colorContrast.description: Scales how different each tile's colour is from the level's average colour (1 = the game's own colours). Lower values make neighbouring tiles harder to tell apart; higher values make the gradient easier to read. Applies from the next level started or restarted.
